headline_stat.name: fraction of place cells with negative phase-position slope (Achilles-10252013)

justification.dataset: DANDI:000044 Grosmark CA1 linear-track recordings are the canonical dataset for hippocampal theta phase precession.
justification.handling: Real data streamed from S3 with correct epoch restriction, lap-direction splitting, and best-theta channel selection; only minor weaknesses (no explicit CA1 region filter despite the claim, low 0.03 m/s run threshold).
justification.analysis: Standard Kempter circular-linear regression with correct signed circular-linear correlation and per-cell parametric significance, plus a 50%-chance population comparison; a spike-shuffle null would strengthen but is not required.
justification.correctness: Reported values reproduce from the committed code and CSV, are internally consistent with the figures, and rest on adequate samples; only a benign 92% vs 93% difference from two code paths.
justification.figures: Example cells (chosen by correlation strength) show clear negative precession bands, and the population slope/ρ distributions and pooled density map make the effect unmistakable with labels and sample sizes.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate to the strong, clean evidence and no figure is contradicted, but there is no explicit limitations section and the 'CA1 units' phrasing slightly overstates the excitatory-only filter.
justification.verdict: A clean, reproducible, well-figured demonstration of phase precession replicated across animals that a rotation student could hand in with only cosmetic revisions.
